run_render_animation: run render_animation to generate MP4 or GIF from 3D pose keypoints and optional input video
run_get_resolution: run get_resolution to extract width and height of a video file using ffprobe
run_get_fps: run get_fps to extract the frame rate of a video file using ffprobe
run_read_video: run read_video to stream video frames as numpy arrays with optional skip and limit
run_downsample_tensor: run downsample_tensor to average-pool a tensor along its first dimension by a given factor
